newsitem.title: USA: StoneMedia in search for CFO.
newsitem.headline: StoneMedia in search for CFO.

text.p: StoneMedia Corp said on Tuesday it has named Anandvichai Dhanasunthorn to lead the company's search for a new chief financial officer.
The company said its current CFO, co-founder Dick Kincaid, turned 70 in October and intended to limit his official role. Kincaid will continue as CFO until a replacement is found, the company said.
Dhanasunthorn is executive advisor to Somkuan Uswachoke, chief executive officer of Alphatec Group, which is based in Bangkok, Thailand, StoneMedia said.
Alphatec's Alpha CommSat Ltd had invested $5 million in StoneMedia in 1996, and agreed to name Kincaid's replacement, the company said.
The Alphatec Group is composed of more than 30 companies, with over 15,000 employees and annual revenue of more than $1.0 billion.

Among the companies in the group is Alphatec Electronics Co Ltd,, which has a joint venture with Texas Instruments Inc. The joint venture plans to build a $1.2 billion semiconductor plant, according to StoneMedia.
